Preserve the original results and exact deployment hashes.

Retain that quality failure, particle bounds, command, source, logs and CSV under docs/roadmap/evidence/F8-26-CANDIDATE-V10-GALLERY-DEBT.json and F9-09. This named scene-quality debt permits F8 integration acceptance under the maintainer's existing F9 scene deferral. All other required Gallery checks and every frozen public/primitive correctness, resource/recovery and work-budget check remain required. Report the separate integration, Gallery-quality and timing verdicts.
